verdict.rationale: SOSPortal documents only per-item ways to get your data back: retrieving your filings from the My Submissions page, and ordering copies and certificates of documents on file, which are paid per document. Nothing describes a bulk or self-serve export of all account data, any open machine-readable format, or an exit or portability process. missing for 10: bulk export of all account data, documented open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), free self-serve export without per-document fees, any account-exit or portability guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
